# Architecture

Ledgerline is one Node.js service (Express) backed by PostgreSQL and an
S3-compatible object store. The same process serves the HTTP API, runs the
import worker, and runs two timers: scheduled exports and the weekly rollup

input.body:
label: question
file: none

Per docs/ARCHITECTURE.md ("What happens to uploaded files"): after a successful import, the worker deletes the uploaded file from object storage and only the parsed transactions are kept. If an import fails, the original file is retained for 7 days (FAILED_UPLOAD_RETENTION_DAYS in src/ingest/worker.ts) to allow inspection, then removed by an hourly purge job. No code change is needed here; this is purely informational for the security review.
